title: Number of Substrings With Only 1s
summary: For a binary string, count the substrings consisting solely of '1's, then return this count modulo 1000000007.
statement: For a binary string, count the substrings consisting solely of '1's, then return this count modulo 1000000007.
constraints: s is a non-empty binary string.
Count substrings containing only ones and return modulo 1,000,000,007.
hints: Track the current consecutive run of ones.
At each one, its run length equals the number of all-one substrings ending there.
Reset the run at zero and add each run value to the answer.
Every all-one substring is counted exactly at its final character.
editorial: Every all-one substring is counted exactly at its final character.

tests.explanation: Runs of lengths two and three contribute three plus six, for nine.
Each isolated one contributes one, for two total.
